records.title: It’s My Park at Wolfe’s Pond Park
records.venue_name: Wolfe's Pond Park (approximate meeting point)
records.description:
DIG+RIDE = FUN Join NYCMTB on the First Saturday of each month to help, build, ride, and maintain the trails at Wolfe’s Pond park in Staten Island. Volunteers help conduct our monthly trail inspection, perform routine maintenance tasks, such as litter pickup raking, erosion control(digging) and signage maintenance. Trail leaders will take teams into the network of trails. NOTICE: 1) Volunteers must arrive on time at 9:00 am. 2) Children 17 and under must be accompanied by an adult. 3) Volunteers must wear durable shoes: boots or sneakers. Volunteer groups may be walking up to a few miles. 4) Read about and protect yourself from ticks. ‘Optional group off-road mountain bike ride at 12:30pm on the trails (The Route: mostly beginner friendly; Distance: ~7 miles). Both groups meet at the Maintenance Shop in the Main Parking lot at Wolfe’s Pond Park 475 Cornelia Ave Staten Island, NY 10312.
Volunteers should meet at the park.
For more information, please email jennifer@nycmtb.org.
